item.title: Founder-market fit: Why it matters more than the idea
item.description: Why founder-market fit matters more than a great idea, and why investors increasingly back founders who deeply understand the market they build for.

item.title: Karnataka govt launches deeptech startup support programme, Elevate NxT
item.description: The programme invites deeptech startups from across India to apply for grant-in-aid support of up to Rs 1 crore per startup, along with milestone-based funding, sector-aligned mentorship, and structured ecosystem support. The applications are open until February 17, 2026.

item.title: From menstrual pain to maternal nutrition: Experts weigh in on women’s health gaps
item.description: A panel discussion hosted by YourStory in collaboration with Bayer brought together healthcare leaders, wellness advocates, and policy experts to address critical gaps in women's health across India.

item.title: Why February is the perfect month for reflective reading
item.description: February is the perfect month for reflective reading. Discover how slow, thoughtful books can help you pause, reconnect, and reset emotionally.

item.title: How connected ERPs and digital collection systems can boost SMEs
item.description: With more streamlined and transparent digital systems, small business owners can devote greater bandwidth to growth, while a clearer digital trail can also open doors to easier and more efficient credit access.

item.title: Why Being a Fool at the Right Time Can Change Everything
item.description: Aldous Huxley’s line, “To be a fool at the right time is also an art,” sounds playful at first, but it carries a sharp, uncomfortable truth.

item.title: Union Budget 2026: Industry seeks growth, innovation, and execution-focused policies
item.description: Startups urge long-term support, predictable regulations, and incentives to enable scaling, early deployment, and global competitiveness.

item.title: Microsoft posts strong AI-led growth as heavy capex continues
item.description: In Q2, Microsoft’s revenue increased 17% year-on-year to $81.3 billion, while its net profit in the quarter surged to $38.5 billion, up 60% from the year-ago period.

item.title: Antler is doubling its checks and speed amidst the flurry of AI companies in India
item.description: Antler, which announced its AI residency programme in July 2025, is looking to reduce its cohort size, going forward, targeting quality founders and ideas. But the firm is also looking to onboard new cohorts every quarter as it begins to adapt to the age of AI.

item.title: 7 Short books that leave a lasting impact on your life
